import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Calculate effect sizes for all features
    effect_sizes = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        effect = abs(np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, i]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, i]))
        tstat = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, i], feats.x[feats.y==0, i]).statistic
        pval = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, i], feats.x[feats.y==0, i]).pvalue
        effect_sizes.append((fid, effect, abs(tstat), pval))
    
    # Sort by effect size and statistical significance
    effect_sizes.sort(key=lambda x: (x[1], x[2]), reverse=True)
    
    # Select top features, avoiding near-duplicates
    selected = []
    for fid, effect, tstat, pval in effect_sizes:
        if len(selected) >= MAX_DRIVERS:
            break
        # Check if this feature is too correlated with already selected ones
        is_duplicate = False
        for selected_fid in selected:
            col_a = feats.column(selected_fid)
            col_b = feats.column(fid)
            corr = abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col_a], feats.x[:, col_b])[0,1])
            if corr > 0.6:
                is_duplicate = True
                break
        if not is_duplicate:
            selected.append(fid)
    
    # If no strong drivers found, return empty design
    if len(selected) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build the final design with minimal terms
    drivers = tuple(selected)
    
    # Include only the drivers in the model to keep it small
    columns = drivers
    
    # No interaction terms to keep model small
    products = ()
    
    # Create weighted score using effect sizes
    loadings = {}
    for fid in selected:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        effect = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, idx])
        loadings[fid] = abs(effect)
    
    # Normalize weights
    total_weight = sum(loadings.values())
    if total_weight > 0:
        for fid in loadings:
            loadings[fid] /= total_weight
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
